headline: AmblyoPunch VR app launches for Meta Quest, offering gamified dichoptic vision training
summary: Developed by Seven Sportz, AmblyoPunch offers a unique dichoptic training system with real-time Gabor pattern generation and a four-stage clinical protocol. It is not FDA/CE certified and is intended as an auxiliary tool under professional guidance.
details: AmblyoPunch, a new VR application developed by Seven Sportz for Meta Quest, introduces a gamified dichoptic vision training system. It is designed to implement a clinically validated four-stage protocol within a virtual reality environment.

The core engineering features independent rendering for each eye, achieved by extending Unity's Universal Render Pipeline (URP) ScriptableRendererFeature to perform two render passes per frame. This approach allows for complete separation of eye-specific shader parameters, essential for precise dichoptic stimulation, despite increasing draw calls.

Gabor stimulus patterns are generated in real-time and offloaded to Compute Shaders to optimize CPU cycles. Parameters are instantly updated via MaterialPropertyBlocks when selected from an in-game wall menu, ensuring hot-reloading without disruptive loading screens.

The app's four-stage clinical protocol is managed by a ClinicalStageController singleton, with material properties swapped before each render pass. Stage transitions are dynamically controlled by a PerformanceGate feedback loop, implementing adaptive difficulty based on a rolling window of 10 outcomes.

Performance is optimized for Meta Quest 2 and 3 to maintain a consistent 72Hz frame rate, achieved by dynamically adjusting GraphicsSettings.lodBias and limiting QualitySettings.pixelLightCount at runtime. The GPU budget of 13.89ms for 72Hz is met with 11.2ms usage, providing a 2.7ms buffer.

AmblyoPunch is not FDA Class II or CE Class IIa medical device certified and is explicitly stated as a vision training aid. It must be used under the diagnosis and guidance of an ophthalmologist or optometrist and is not a standalone treatment.

The engineering design allows clinical researchers to adjust Gabor parameters via ScriptableObject lookup tables in the Unity editor without requiring new builds. Future updates aim for a 30% GPU budget reduction through single-pass stereo rendering and eye-tracking based foveated rendering.

headline_marked: [[RepoXray offers zero-upload security scanning]] for supply-chain, slopsquatting, and secrets
headline: RepoXray offers zero-upload security scanning for supply-chain, slopsquatting, and secrets
summary: RepoXray audits repositories for supply-chain risks, slopsquatting, and secrets before npm install or integrating AI coding agents, ensuring pre-emptive security.
details: RepoXray is a new open-source tool designed to audit code repositories for security vulnerabilities without requiring any uploads. It helps developers proactively identify risks before running npm install or integrating AI coding agents into their workflows.

The scanner targets critical threats including supply-chain attacks, slopsquatting, and exposed secrets, aiming to prevent malicious code from entering development environments. Its zero-upload approach enhances privacy and security for sensitive projects.

Beyond traditional security, RepoXray also addresses AI-specific concerns by calculating LLM context bloat. It compiles tailored .aiignore and AGENTS.md guardrails, alongside a remediation prompt, to manage AI agent interactions securely.

The developer is seeking technical feedback on false positives or missing detection rules to improve the tool's accuracy and coverage. The project is available on GitHub for community contributions and review.
caption:
